svg.aria-label: 7 days old: Renovate opens an update PR only when the release is 7 days old. This blocks a hijacked release that is pulled within days. Auto-merge: dev patches only: Only patch updates of dev dependencies merge automatically, after the 7 days and green CI. Security fixes do not wait: Security fixes (vulnerabilityAlerts) do not wait. They get the label security. Never automatic: Majors, base images, Biome and @synthwerk/* packages never merge automatically
